steps.en: Search results appear as a summary list, one row per notice
steps.id: Hasil pencarian tampil sebagai tabel ringkasan, satu baris per notice

steps.en: Newest notices by date and time are listed first
steps.id: Notice dengan tanggal dan waktu terbaru ditampilkan paling atas
steps.why_en: Only the outstanding view sorts by newest date; the main all-notices view sorts by processing stage first.
steps.why_id: Hanya tampilan outstanding yang urut tanggal terbaru; tampilan semua notice urut processing stage dulu.

steps.en: Staff can re-sort the list by any column header
steps.id: Staff bisa mengurutkan ulang tabel lewat header kolom
steps.why_en: Sorting works, but the payment status sort fix is still waiting for user testing.
steps.why_id: Pengurutan berfungsi, tetapi perbaikan sort status bayar masih menunggu uji pengguna.

steps.en: The list shows notice number, date and time, offence rule, amount
steps.id: Tabel menampilkan nomor notice, tanggal dan waktu, offence rule, jumlah bayar

steps.en: Staff can filter notices by outstanding or settled status
steps.id: Staff bisa memfilter notice berdasarkan status outstanding atau lunas
